page.notes: Several entries are read with some doubt and carry no [?] marker: "malï" in the right column is read as "mali", and "Israelitarum" as "Israelitarum". The right-column line "conscientiæ stimulus obtusus ut redda tur" and the word "Domini" at the foot of that column are printed with odd spacing and a line break; they are copied as they stand. The last line of the right column is printed slightly lower on the page. The left column header "tœna mystica" has an uncertain first letter, possibly "cœna". The middle column line "confusio quid sit 219 a. 273 b" is printed with unusual numbers and may contain a misprint. Page number absent from the scan.
